rows.answer_text: Visakoivu Oy holds a valid LUSA-patevyys (LVI- ja sahkourakointi) covering the field of activity required for this framework agreement, valid until 31 March 2027.
Visakoivu Oy maintains liability insurance (toiminnan vastuuvakuutus) with cover of EUR 2,000,000, which exceeds the minimum threshold required in clause 3.2.
Visakoivu Oy holds Sahkourakointioikeudet, luokka S1, which satisfies the minimum requirement of class S2.
Building envelope condition is assessed during scheduled property inspections, with defects and deterioration logged and fed into the preventive maintenance plan for each building.

Visakoivu Oy employs around 180 staff across its technical disciplines, allowing more than one qualified person to be assigned to each account so that service continues without interruption if an individual team member leaves or changes role.

Estate management receives regular written maintenance reports covering completed and outstanding work orders, condition findings and any recommended remedial work, on a schedule agreed with the buyer.

Quality control and testing on maintenance and installation work is carried out under Visakoivu Oy's NMSB 7310:2015 quality management system, including documented inspection and sign-off before work is closed out.

Periodic statutory inspections of electrical installations are carried out by personnel operating under Visakoivu Oy's Sahkourakointioikeudet, luokka S1, with inspection records kept and made available to the buyer.

Elevator servicing is arranged through an accredited elevator-maintenance subcontractor under Visakoivu Oy's subcontractor management framework, with Visakoivu Oy remaining responsible for ensuring the work meets applicable elevator safety regulations and for reporting the results to the buyer.

Site personnel operate under Visakoivu Oy's NMSB 75310:2018 occupational health and safety system and hold the qualifications required for their trade, including LUSA-patevyys and Sahkourakointioikeudet, luokka S1, for electrical work.

Visakoivu Oy provides a warranty on installed equipment and materials in line with standard industry practice and the relevant manufacturer terms, with the applicable warranty period confirmed per item at project sign-off.
Visakoivu Oy proposes an annual price adjustment linked to a nationally published cost index for building maintenance services, applied once per contract year.
Visakoivu Oy will provide a full cost breakdown by service line and building, in the format requested by the buyer.
Visakoivu Oy will price the framework agreement in euro.
Visakoivu Oy will invoice monthly in arrears, itemised by work order, in the format required by the buyer's accounts function.
A current certificate of pension insurance payments (todistus elakevakuutusmaksuista) for Visakoivu Oy is enclosed with this quotation.
An insurance certificate confirming Visakoivu Oy's liability insurance cover of EUR 2,000,000 is enclosed with this quotation.
This quotation will be submitted before the stated deadline of 6 October 2026, 15:00 (EET).
The reference currency for all framework agreement pricing is euro.
This quotation is provided as a single PDF file with no password protection.

Visakoivu Oy will provide short familiarisation sessions for the buyer's own property staff on the systems it maintains, covering routine checks and how to raise a fault, at a schedule agreed with estate management.
A method statement describing sequencing, access arrangements and safety measures for installation works is provided for each work order before work begins on site.
Visakoivu Oy maintains stock of common spare and wear parts and sources non-stocked parts through established supplier relationships, with delivery times confirmed per item at the time of order.

Fire-protection systems are serviced as part of Visakoivu Oy's building-services maintenance, with statutory inspection and certification testing carried out by accredited fire-safety subcontractors where specialist certification is required, and records kept and reported to the buyer.

Visakoivu Oy provides round-the-clock on-call duty within Finland, covering the estate through its LVI, sahko and kiinteistonhoito teams, and confirms this satisfies the binding condition at Liite A, clause 3.2.
Where subcontractors are used, their costs are itemised separately in the cost breakdown provided to the buyer, so that subcontractor pricing is transparent within the overall quotation price.
CVs of the key personnel proposed for this framework agreement, covering the relevant LVI, sahko, rakennusautomaatio and kiinteistonhoito disciplines, are enclosed with this quotation.
The confidentiality undertaking referenced in clause 2.2 is signed by Visakoivu Oy's authorised representative and returned with this quotation.

general_sections.cover_letter: Visakoivu Oy is pleased to submit this quotation for the technical maintenance framework agreement, reference RAUTAPORTTI-RFQ-2026-09. We have read the request in full, including both annexes, and have addressed every point raised.
general_sections.company_overview: Visakoivu Oy is a technical and property services company based in Jyvaskyla, founded in 1994, with around 180 employees working across LVI, sahko, rakennusautomaatio and kiinteistonhoito. The company holds NMSB 7310, NMSB 74210 and NMSB 75310 certification, LUSA-patevyys and Sahkourakointioikeudet, and delivers maintenance outsourcing, installation and framework-agreement work for public and private clients across Keski-Suomi.
